resources.string: Network access to files

Lets a paired device with full rights browse this device's storage and take files, see and edit its shared folders, and read its log and diagnostics report.
• Off, none of this is anybody's from afar, whatever full control says.
• A guest given full rights for a while gets the files only if this was on when they were given.
• It is switched on here and nowhere else.
Open this device\'s files to the network?

A paired device with full rights will be able to see the name of every file in this device\'s storage and have any of them sent to itself, see, add and remove shared folders, and read the app\'s log and diagnostics report.\n\nSecrets are scrubbed from the log, but a filter is a filter. Whoever holds such a device holds all of this.
